# How to Find the GSTIN, CIN and PAN of Any Business


November 27, 2026


[Shashank Yadav](https://salarybox.in/blog/author/shashank87cc9f270b/)


[No comments yet](https://salarybox.in/blog/how-to-find-the-gstin-cin-and-pan-of-any-business/#respond)


**Short answer:** search the business’s name on[Business Graph by Compose1](https://compose1.ai/apps/business-graph/) , a free business search tool, to see its GSTIN and CIN together. Then read its PAN straight from the GSTIN: characters 3 to 12 of any GSTIN are the business’s PAN. To confirm the numbers officially, use the GST portal’s Search Taxpayer page and the MCA portal’s “Find CIN” service. The whole thing takes about 2 minutes.


You’re filling in a vendor’s details in Tally, and the GSTIN field is blank. Or the customer’s PO has a company name but no CIN for your contract. Or HR needs the PAN of a staffing agency for TDS. You know the business is real; you just need its numbers, and you need them now.


Most guides online cover one number at a time, each on a different website. But these three IDs are linked, and once you see how, you can find all of them in one go.


## GSTIN, CIN and PAN at a glance


**ID** **Who issues it** **Who has one** **Format** **Example**


PAN Income Tax Department Every taxpaying business and person 10 characters: 5 letters, 4 digits, 1 letter AAACX1234X


GSTIN GST Network Businesses registered for GST, one per state 15 characters: state code + PAN + entity number + Z + check character 27AAACX1234X1Z5


CIN Ministry of Corporate Affairs Only companies (private, public, OPC) 21 characters U72200MH2015PTC012345


*Examples are made up, to show the format.*


**The key thing to know:** a GSTIN contains the PAN. So if you find the GSTIN, you’ve found the PAN too. And LLPs get an LLPIN (like AAB-1234) instead of a CIN.


## The fastest way: find all three on Business Graph


[Business Graph](https://compose1.ai/apps/business-graph/) is a free search engine for Indian businesses, made by Compose1. It brings GST and company registration records together, so one search gives you the numbers that other sites split across separate tools.


1. **Search the business.** Type its name, brand, website or even what it does, like “steel traders in Ludhiana”. If you already have one ID, search by that: GSTIN, CIN, PAN or pincode all work.
2. **Open the right result.** Check the city and address to pick the right business when names are similar.
3. **Copy the GSTIN and CIN.** Both are on the business’s page with its GST and company registration details.
4. **Read the PAN from the GSTIN.** Take characters 3 to 12. Done.


Because Business Graph also covers proprietorships and partnerships through their GST records, it works for the small traders and contractors that company-only sites miss. You can also start a search straight from the[Compose1 home page](https://compose1.ai/) .


## How to find a GSTIN (GST number)


### From the business itself


Every GST-registered business must print its GSTIN on its tax invoices. Check a bill, a quotation or the website footer first. It’s also on the GST certificate displayed at their premises.


### On the GST portal


- **If you have the PAN:** go to gst.gov.in, open Search Taxpayer, choose “Search by PAN”, enter the PAN and captcha. You’ll see every GSTIN linked to it, with the state and status. No login needed.
- **If you only have the name:** the portal’s name search only covers some taxpayers, so it often finds nothing. Use Business Graph instead.
- **To check a GSTIN you already have:** choose “Search by GSTIN/UIN” to see the legal name, trade name, status and principal place of business. Or use SalaryBox’s free[GST number search tool](https://salarybox.in/gst-number-search/) .


New to GST numbers? Our guide on[what a GST number is](https://salarybox.in/blog/what-is-a-gst-number/) explains the basics.


## How to find a CIN


- **On the company’s own paperwork.** Under the Companies Act, a company must print its CIN on its letterheads, invoices and other official documents, and on its website. Scroll to the website footer or check a bill.
- **On the MCA portal.** Use the “Find CIN” service at mca.gov.in and search by company name. Then open the company’s master data to confirm its status.
- **On Business Graph.** Search the name and the CIN is on the company’s page, next to its GST details.


**No CIN found?** The business might not be a company. Proprietorships and partnerships don’t have a CIN, and LLPs have an LLPIN instead.


### What a CIN tells you


**Part** **Example** **Meaning**


1st character U L = listed on a stock exchange, U = unlisted


Next 5 digits 72200 Industry code (NIC) of the main business activity


Next 2 letters MH State where it’s registered


Next 4 digits 2015 Year of incorporation


Next 3 letters PTC Type of company, e.g. PTC = private limited, PLC = public limited, OPC = one person company


Last 6 digits 012345 Registration number


So U72200MH2015PTC012345 is an unlisted private limited company, registered in Maharashtra in 2015. Handy for a quick sense check: if a company claims 20 years in business but its CIN says 2023, ask questions.


## How to find a PAN


- **From the GSTIN (easiest).** Characters 3 to 12 of the GSTIN are the PAN.
- **From the business’s documents.** PAN often appears on invoices, Form 16A and TDS certificates.
- **Ask for it.** If you’re paying a vendor and need to deduct TDS, it’s normal to ask for their PAN in your vendor form.


There’s no official public search that finds a business’s PAN by name, which is why the GSTIN route is so useful.


### What the 4th letter of a PAN tells you


**4th letter** **Type of holder**


C Company


F Firm or LLP


P Individual (including a sole proprietor)


H Hindu Undivided Family (HUF)


A Association of persons


T Trust


G Government


**A word of care:** if the 4th letter is P, the PAN belongs to a person, not a company. Use it only for genuine business purposes like billing and TDS, and don’t share it further. Under India’s DPDP Act, a person’s PAN is personal data.


## Which method should you use?


**You have…** **You need…** **Fastest way**


Just the name GSTIN and CIN[Business Graph](https://compose1.ai/apps/business-graph/)


The GSTIN PAN Read characters 3 to 12


The PAN All GSTINs GST portal: Search by PAN

A website Any ID Website footer, or search the website on Business Graph


## Common mistakes to avoid


- **Using the wrong state’s GSTIN.** A business registered in several states has a different GSTIN in each. Use the one for the state on the invoice, or your input tax credit can be blocked.
- **Mixing up trade name and legal name.** “Sharma Sweets” may be legally “Rakesh Kumar Sharma”. Match your records to the legal name on the GST record.
- **Trusting a number without checking its status.** A cancelled GSTIN or a struck-off CIN is a real number for a business that can’t trade. Always check the status.
- **Typing errors.** A GSTIN’s last character is a check character, so a single typo usually makes it invalid. Copy and paste instead of retyping.

## Frequently asked questions


### How can I find the GST number of a company by its name?


Search the company’s name on Business Graph by Compose1, a free business search tool, and it shows the business’s GSTIN along with its address and registration details. The GST portal also has a name search, but it only covers some taxpayers, so a name search there often comes back empty.


### How do I find a company’s PAN from its GST number?


Look at characters 3 to 12 of the GSTIN: that is the business’s PAN. For example, in the GSTIN 27AAACX1234X1Z5, the PAN is AAACX1234X. This works because every regular GSTIN is built from the business’s PAN.


### How can I find the CIN of a company?


Search the company on Business Graph or use the “Find CIN” service on the MCA portal. Companies must also print their CIN on their letterheads, invoices and website, so check a bill or the website footer. Only companies and LLPs have a CIN; proprietorships and partnerships don’t.


### Can I find all the GST numbers of one business?


Yes. On the GST portal, use Search Taxpayer and then “Search by PAN”, enter the business’s PAN and the captcha, and you’ll see every GSTIN linked to that PAN, with its state and status. A business gets a separate GSTIN for each state it’s registered in.


### What is the difference between GSTIN, CIN and PAN?


PAN is a business’s income tax number, issued by the Income Tax Department. GSTIN is its GST registration number, one per state, with the PAN inside it. CIN is the registration number the Ministry of Corporate Affairs gives a company. Every business has a PAN, GST-registered ones have a GSTIN, and only companies have a CIN.


### Does a sole proprietorship have a CIN?


No. A sole proprietorship isn’t registered with the MCA, so it has no CIN. Its PAN is the owner’s personal PAN, and if it’s registered for GST, its GSTIN contains that personal PAN. Treat it as personal data and use it only for genuine business purposes like billing and tax.


### What is Business Graph?


Business Graph is a free business search tool by Compose1 (compose1.ai) for Indian businesses. You can search by name, brand, GSTIN, CIN, PAN, pincode, website, product or plain words, and see a business’s GST and company registration details, addresses, websites, key people and connected businesses on one page. It also has an API.


## The bottom line


Remember one thing and this gets easy: the PAN lives inside the GSTIN. Find the GSTIN and CIN with one search, read the PAN from the GSTIN, and confirm on the government portals when it matters.
